name: Countable

source.code:
/-- A type `α` is countable if there exists an injective map `α → ℕ`. -/
@[mk_iff countable_iff_exists_injective]
class Countable (α : Sort u) : Prop where
  /-- A type `α` is countable if there exists an injective map `α → ℕ`. -/
  exists_injective_nat' : ∃ f : α → ℕ, Injective f
